verdict.rationale: A direct probe for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec at all standard locations (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on all paths, and no docs page links to a machine-readable API spec. The llms.txt and markdown-mirrored docs are AI-readable documentation, not a formal API spec (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/etc.).
